jd:
Full-Stack Engineer - Pinecrest Commerce

About the role
Pinecrest sells outdoor equipment online. The full-stack team ships weekly. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build features across the Node.js backend and React frontend
- Own database changes
- Write tests and review code

Requirements
- Node.js backend development
- React
- TypeScript
- MongoDB
- REST API design
- AWS deployment experience

Nice to have
- Docker
- Jest

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks

qa.question: Which databases has the candidate used?
What frontend library does the candidate use?
Has the candidate used MongoDB?
qa.expected_answer: MongoDB is not mentioned; the candidate used PostgreSQL.

notes: TypeScript earns partial credit for JavaScript; Mocha is not Jest, so the nice-to-have is missing. A model that substitutes 'a database' for MongoDB will overclaim.
